title: Full Stack Developer
description:
THE HUSTLE HOUSE · NOW HIRING
 



 Full Stack Developer
 



  





 Live products. Real ownership from day one.
 



 Production software for real clients — not tickets, not mockups.
 



 One seat. Apply if you've shipped things that work.
 



  





 \\-\\-\\-
 



  





 AT A GLANCE
 



 • Department: Development
 



 • Reports To: Full\\-Stack Lead — direct line to founders
 



 • Seats Open: 1 — one candidate, no exceptions
 



 • Employment Type: Full\\-time, in\\-office — Indore, India
 



 • Starting Compensation: ₹20,000–35,000/month to start (see note below)
 



 • Tooling Provided: AI \\& productivity tooling — on THH
 



  





 \\-\\-\\-
 



  





 THE OFFER
 



 Most job posts give you a task list, a manager three levels up, and a generic perks page. Here's the actual offer — laid out so you can evaluate it clearly.
 



  





 • Ship on Live Products
 



 Why it matters: Real products, paying clients, real users. Not mock apps. What most developers spend years trying to get on their resume.
 



  





 • Modern AI Toolchain, On Us
 



 Why it matters: AI coding tools, LLM access, and automation platforms — the tools senior engineers usually pay for out of their own pocket. Meaningful market value, provided free while you work here.
 



  





 • Direct Founder Access
 



 Why it matters: You report to the Full\\-Stack Lead and have a direct line to the founders. No layers, no bureaucracy. Mentorship most developers don't get until years into a career.
 



  





 • Full Portfolio Attribution
 



 Why it matters: Every task you ship is credited to you — git commits, live URLs, build records, yours to claim. A real, attributable track record. Not "contributed to a team project."
 



  





 • Real Ownership From Day One
 



 Why it matters: Your first real task ships in week one, on a live product. Not a sandbox, not onboarding busywork. Immediate proof, immediate feedback, immediate confidence.
 



  





 • Room to Grow
 



 Why it matters: Compensation and scope are reviewed as you prove impact — this range is a starting point, not a ceiling. Upside for people who perform, without a capped band to work against.
 



  





 A note on pay: we're starting new hires in the ₹20,000–35,000/month range while we calibrate to the market and the calibre of people applying. The final offer is based on the skill you demonstrate through the hiring process, and it moves fast for people who prove themselves.
 



  





 \\-\\-\\-
 



  





 THE COMPANY
 



 The Hustle House is a founder\\-led, AI\\-native studio building brands, digital products, and growth systems for clients who expect premium performance. Intentionally small. Tight senior crew. Fast.
 



  





 We build and ship live products for real, paying clients — not prototypes, not concepts. You'd be working directly with the same small team that builds and runs them.
 



 No management layers, no 60\\-day onboarding plans, no busywork that goes nowhere.
 



  





 \\-\\-\\-
 



  





 THE STACK
 



 • Languages \\& runtimes: JavaScript / Node.js, Python, React
 



 • Infrastructure: Cloud infrastructure, REST APIs, webhooks
 



 • AI tooling: AI coding assistants, LLM APIs, automation \\& voice\\-AI platforms
 



  





 \\-\\-\\-
 



  





 THE ROLE
 



 What This Is
 



 You'll handle well\\-defined development work that becomes critical infrastructure for our live products — the kind of work that quietly blocks the senior team until someone owns it. This isn't a training role. You'll be shipping production code in week one, and your scope grows as fast as you do.
 



  





 Who This Is For
 



 • You've built and shipped something — a side project, a freelance gig, a tool people actually use.
 



 • You can show it or explain it clearly.
 



 • You're comfortable reading and writing code in at least one language. JS or Python preferred.
 



 • You debug independently. You read the error before asking for help.
 



 • You're reliable. If it's due tomorrow, it's done tomorrow.
 



 • You build things whether or not someone is paying you to.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 



 • Build and maintain features across our live, revenue\\-generating products.
 



 • Own live integrations — webhook endpoints, API connections, data pipeline fixes.
 



 • Ship bug patches, test runs, data cleanups, and minor feature builds independently.
 



 • Flag things that look broken, even if it isn't your task.
 



 • Work directly with the Full\\-Stack Lead on architecture decisions as your ownership grows.
 



  





 Bonus — Nice to Have
 



 • You've used AI coding tools, or are actively learning them.
 



 • You've touched webhooks, APIs, or automation platforms.
 



 • You have a GitHub with real activity. Size doesn't matter. Consistency does.
 



 • Startup, freelance, or founder\\-mode experience.
 



  





 \\-\\-\\-
 



  





 THE FIRST 90 DAYS
 



 • Day 30: Your first feature is live on a real product. You know the codebase well enough to move without asking where things are.
 



 • Day 60: You're closing tasks without hand\\-holding. You've caught and flagged at least one issue the senior team missed.
 



 • Day 90: You're taking on bigger, less\\-defined pieces. Your scope and compensation are reviewed based on impact.
 



  





 \\-\\-\\-
 



  





 BE AWARE
 



 No HR department. No fixed increment cycles. No big\\-company benefits — health insurance, PF, and paid leave aren't part of the package yet, and we'd rather tell you that upfront than have you find out later.
 



  





 What there is: real ownership, direct founder access, and a toolchain most companies won't give a junior developer.
 



  





 If you need a structured environment with a defined career ladder to stay motivated, this isn't the right fit yet — and that's okay. If what you just read sounds like exactly what you've been looking for, keep going.
 



  





 \\-\\-\\-
 



  





 OUR COMMITMENT
 



 • Real production work from week one. Not busywork.
 



 • Direct access to the founders. Not a middle manager.
 



 • Every tool you need — modern AI stack included — at no cost to you.
 



 • Full attribution for everything you ship. Your commits are your portfolio.
 



 • Compensation reviewed transparently as you prove impact.
 



  





 \\-\\-\\-
 



  





 NEXT STEP — HOW TO APPLY
 



 Send your CV to sanidhya@thehustlehouseofficial.com or ishaan@thehustlehouseofficial.com.
 



  





 In three to five sentences: what have you built, what problem did it solve, and what would you do differently if you started today? That's the only filter.
 



  





 We don't care about your GPA. We care about what you've shipped. Link your GitHub, live project, or portfolio if you have one — if you don't, make the written answer specific enough to make up for it.
 



  





 One seat. We read every application. If yours describes something real, we'll respond fast.
